articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 Turbo with Native Multimodal Reasoning Across Code, Vision, and Audio
articles.summary: OpenAI released GPT-5 Turbo, featuring deeply integrated multimodal reasoning that can simultaneously process and cross-reference code repositories, visual diagrams, and spoken instructions in a single inference pass. Benchmarks show a 40% improvement over GPT-5 on complex software architecture tasks. The model introduces a new 'chain-of-thought grounding' mechanism that significantly reduces hallucination rates in technical domains.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 Achieves State-of-the-Art on Mathematical Olympiad Problems
articles.summary: DeepMind announced that Gemini Ultra 2 solved 89% of International Mathematical Olympiad problems from the last decade, a significant leap from the previous best of 72%. The system uses a novel reinforcement learning approach combining formal proof verification with natural-language reasoning. Researchers say the architecture could accelerate automated theorem proving and formal verification in production software systems.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Begins Supervised Deployment in Third-Party Warehouses
articles.summary: Tesla confirmed that its Optimus Gen 3 humanoid robots have started supervised shifts in Amazon and DHL fulfillment centers, performing bin-picking, palletizing, and inventory scanning tasks. The robots operate with a new vision-language-action model that allows them to interpret natural-language task descriptions and adapt to novel object geometries in real time. Tesla reports a 3x improvement in manipulation dexterity over Gen 2, though human oversight remains required for edge cases.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics and Hyundai Unveil Atlas Commercial Platform with Whole-Body Predictive Control
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics officially launched the commercial Atlas platform built on a new whole-body model-predictive control stack that enables the humanoid to carry up to 35 kg while navigating unstructured construction environments. The system integrates real-time 3D scene reconstruction with dynamic balance algorithms, allowing it to traverse rubble and climb ladders. Initial deployments are planned with Hyundai's construction and shipbuilding divisions in Q1 2027.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces 'Constitutional Classifiers' for Enterprise AI Safety Compliance
articles.summary: Anthropic released a new framework called Constitutional Classifiers, which layers lightweight classifier heads on top of foundation models to enforce domain-specific safety and compliance policies without retraining. The system allows enterprises to define behavioral constraints in natural language that are compiled into real-time inference-time guardrails. Early adopters in healthcare and finance report near-zero policy violation rates with less than 4% latency overhead.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm Gate-All-Around Process Node
articles.summary: TSMC announced volume production of its N14G process, the company's first 1.4nm gate-all-around (GAA) nanosheet node, with Apple and Nvidia confirmed as lead customers for 2027 silicon. The node delivers a 20% performance gain and 30% power reduction over the N2 node, critical for next-generation AI accelerators constrained by datacenter power budgets. Yield rates are reportedly exceeding TSMC's internal targets, suggesting aggressive ramp-up timelines are feasible.

articles.title: Meta Open-Sources Llama 4 Mixture-of-Experts Model with 1.2 Trillion Parameters
articles.summary: Meta released Llama 4 under a permissive open license, featuring a sparse mixture-of-experts architecture with 1.2 trillion total parameters but only 90 billion active per forward pass. The model matches or exceeds GPT-5 on most public benchmarks while being runnable on a single 8×H200 node, dramatically lowering the hardware barrier for frontier-class AI research. The release includes training recipes, RLHF datasets, and a new distributed inference framework optimized for commodity clusters.

articles.title: Breakthrough Solid-State Battery from QuantumScape Hits 1,000-Cycle Milestone in EV Road Tests
articles.summary: QuantumScape reported that its solid-state lithium-metal batteries have surpassed 1,000 full charge-discharge cycles in real-world EV testing with a partner automaker, retaining over 90% capacity. The cells achieve an energy density of 500 Wh/kg, nearly double conventional lithium-ion, and support 15-minute charging to 80%. This milestone addresses the key durability concern that has historically blocked solid-state commercialization, with pilot production slated for mid-2027.
